title: Telescope with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="5" fill="#AEEBFF"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->

  <circle cx="37" cy="43" r="3" fill="#FF9F6B" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="43" r="3" fill="#FF9F6B" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Star on tube -->
  <path d="M 66 24 L 67.5 27.5 L 71 28 L 68.5 30.5 L 69.5 34 L 66 32.5 L 62.5 34 L 63.5 30.5 L 61 28 L 64.5 27.5 Z" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
